name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-kling
title: Kling
description: Kling AI video generation MCP server for Model Context Protocol hosts

environmentVariables.name: KLING_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Outbound HTTP request timeout in milliseconds (max 1800000)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Workspace directory that local media inputs and downloads are constrained to. Defaults to the system temp directory when unset.

environmentVariables.name: KLING_DOWNLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox root for download_kling_video outputs. Must resolve inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH. Defaults to <workspace>/kling-downloads.
